spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) as time, SUM(bit_count)/$__interval_s AS rate FROM data_flow WHERE device_id = '${device_id}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  concat(
    src_as_id,
    ':',
    dictGet('meta_as_dict', 'name', src_as_id)
  ) AS src_as_name,
  concat(
    dst_as_id,
    ':',
    dictGet ('meta_as_dict', 'name', dst_as_id)
  ) AS dst_as_name,
  SUM(bit_count)/$__interval_s AS rate
FROM
  data_flow AS flow
WHERE
-- Limit to top AS pairs for entire time range by volume, then outer query just grabs those pairs
  (src_as_id, dst_as_id) IN (
    SELECT
      (src_as_id, dst_as_id)
    FROM
      data_flow
    WHERE
      device_id='${device_id}'
      AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
    GROUP BY
      src_as_id,
      dst_as_id
    ORDER BY
      SUM(bit_count) DESC
    LIMIT
      10
  )
  AND device_id='${device_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  src_as_id,
  dst_as_id,
  time
ORDER BY
  time ASC,
  rate DESC
